Sets the volume of a bus, at once or over a fade time. A channel is as loud as its own volume times the volume of its bus and of every bus that bus feeds, master included. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
; Everything fades out over two seconds.
AudioBusVolume 0, 0, 2000
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@param volume  `1` is the full volume, `0` silence. Above 1 makes the bus louder. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@param fade_ms  How many milliseconds it takes to get to the new volume. `0` (the default) changes it at once. Below 0 is a runtime error.
@gap The volume glides over every block of sound, so a fade has no steps, also when the program does not call Flip or Delay. [GetAudioBusVolume](GetAudioBusVolume) tells the volume.
